title: Reusable core session authentication seam
description: Objective: expose one reusable, fail-closed core decision for session, credential, proof-of-possession, replay, expiry, and transport authentication, then have authenticateCommand compose it before command capability admission. This is the prerequisite that lets daemon coordination authenticate a session without fabricating a RuntimeCommandEnvelope or forking core precedence. NOT in scope: choosing a cryptographic proof algorithm, persistence, daemon wiring, recipient/effect registries, or coordination mailbox behavior. Owned paths: packages/core/src/identity/authenticate-session.ts, packages/core/src/identity/authenticate-session.js, packages/core/src/identity/authenticate-session.test.ts, packages/core/src/identity/authenticate-command.ts, packages/core/src/index.ts. Production consumer: Durable daemon session and coordination-recipient authority, then task-4afcb06422ed4adb89430b7ea9758d7f. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/core test && pnpm typecheck.
definitionOfDone: A frozen reusable session-authentication result validates the committed principal, session, credential, presented proof, verifier result, replay result, expiry, generation, client key, and transport facts without accepting caller-supplied positive booleans as authority.

Every refusal preserves the exact stable core code and refusing layer with AUTHENTICATION_FAILED before SESSION_REPLAYED before SESSION_EXPIRED, returns zero principal/session authority, and UNKNOWN or malformed verifier/replay evidence denies.

authenticateCommand delegates session authentication to the new production seam and only then applies its existing exact RuntimeCommand capability check; its public behavior and existing tests remain byte-for-byte compatible.

Focused tests cover success and every refusal/precedence branch, assert code plus layer and zero-authority output, assert generated-case counts, and mutation-drill each production guard so bypassing it turns the focused test red.
The exact verification command exits 0 and the daemon authority prerequisite is named as the real consumer; no proof algorithm, persistence, or coordination capability mapping is introduced here.
taskRails: Keep the core decision pure and dependency-free; injected proof/replay observations are evidence inputs, never inferred truth.
Do not add coordination endpoint strings to RuntimeCommandKind or synthesize fake runtime commands.
Preserve all existing identity authentication reason codes, layers, and precedence.
